open_points.subject: Model M23 — SectionPlan creation
open_points.text:
when an imported budget is built stays open
  question Q11 of `open_questions.md`
open_points.question: When are the imported BudgetVersion and its SectionPlan entities created, despite this unit declaring that it has no open questions?
options: Create them when the snapshot import is accepted
Create them in a later action that turns the accepted snapshot into an activation candidate
open_points.default_guess: Create them in a later explicit candidate-building action.

witness.initial: An approved snapshot has been accepted, but no imported BudgetVersion or SectionPlan exists for it.
events: An operator lists budget versions or attempts to review the imported snapshot for activation.
outcomes: The imported BudgetVersion and SectionPlans already exist because import created them.
They do not exist until a separate candidate-building action occurs.
witness.observer: The operator and any reader of budget-version history

open_points.subject: Model M23 — SectionPlan.updated_at
open_points.text:
an imported plan's
  `updated_by` is `None` and its `updated_at` the import's instant
open_points.question: Which instant is stored as an imported SectionPlan.updated_at when snapshot acceptance and construction of the imported budget occur at different times?
options: The instant the imported BudgetVersion and SectionPlans are constructed
open_points.default_guess: Use the instant the imported BudgetVersion and SectionPlans are constructed.

witness.initial: A snapshot is accepted at T1 and its imported budget is built at T2.
events: The system creates a SectionPlan from the snapshot at T2.
outcomes: updated_at is T1, the snapshot import instant.
updated_at is T2, the plan-construction instant.
witness.observer: Staff reading budget history or audit-related metadata

open_points.subject: Model M35 — ProgressPhoto update metadata
open_points.text:
an
  accepted update sets them again
open_points.question: Does a photo metadata request whose caption, section and visibility equal the stored values count as an accepted update that advances updated_at and updated_by, or is it rejected/treated as an unchanged read?
open_points.default_guess: Accept it and stamp updated_at/updated_by, matching the explicit Expense and ExpenseDocument policies.

witness.initial: A published photo has caption C, section S, visibility true and update metadata from T1.
events: At T2, a staff member submits an update containing the same caption C, section S and visibility true.
outcomes: updated_at and updated_by change to T2 and the acting staff member.
The stored update metadata remains from T1, or the request is refused.
witness.observer: Staff reading the photo or audit/change metadata

open_points.subject: Model M35 — ProgressPhoto.updated_at and updated_by
open_points.text: are never `None` on a published photo
open_points.question: Must the persisted ProgressPhoto fields be non-nullable, or may a persisted photo have null updated_at/updated_by as the declared optional fields permit?
options: Both fields are required on every persisted ProgressPhoto
Both fields remain optional and some persisted photos may contain null
open_points.default_guess: Make both fields required because every ProgressPhoto is created by publication.

witness.initial: A new photo is successfully published.
events: The persistence model is instantiated and stored.
A reader loads the new photo.
outcomes: updated_at and updated_by equal published_at and published_by and cannot be null.
The optional field declarations permit the stored photo to have null update metadata.
witness.observer: The repository, serializers and staff photo readers

open_points.subject: PhotoMutationResult.updated_at
open_points.question: When can PhotoMutationResult.updated_at be None now that every new published photo has non-null update metadata and every accepted update sets it again?
options: Never; change the result field to datetime
On an accepted update treated as a no-op

witness.initial: Every persisted ProgressPhoto has a non-null updated_at.
events: A publication or metadata mutation succeeds.
outcomes: The result always contains the persisted datetime.
The nullable result contract allows None for the same successful operation.

open_points.subject: ProjectValidationResult
open_points.text:
- `ProjectValidationResult` — `project_id: UUID`, `exists: bool`,
  `status: str | None`, `is_active: bool`, `failure: str | None`.
open_points.rule:
Каждая runtime-модель без `kind` обязана объявлять
  `identity: "value"|"entity"`; модели с `kind` поле `identity` не содержат.
open_points.question: The passage must declare ProjectValidationResult as identity "value" or "entity"; for this transient Registry answer it should become an explicit value model.

open_points.subject: Model M23 — SectionPlan fields
open_points.text:
`updated_at`, `updated_by | None` (manual plans only: an imported plan's
  `updated_by` is `None` and its `updated_at` the import's instant; the
  author of an imported version stays on `BudgetVersion.created_by_id`,
  owner 2026-11-08, Q05; when an imported budget is built stays open
  question Q11 of `open_questions.md`).
open_points.question: The passage must give explicit types for updated_at and updated_by, including the intended nullability.

open_points.subject: Model M28 — Expense fields
open_points.question: The passage must become typed declarations, such as updated_at: datetime | None and updated_by: UUID | None.

open_points.subject: Model M30 — ExpenseDocument fields
open_points.question: The passage must give explicit types for created_at, updated_at and updated_by.

open_points.subject: Model M35 — ProgressPhoto fields
open_points.text:
`published_at`,
  `published_by: UUID`, `section_id: UUID | None`, `caption: str | None`,
  `client_visible: bool`, `updated_at | None`, `updated_by | None`.
open_points.question: The passage must give explicit types for published_at, updated_at and updated_by and must make the latter two non-nullable if the new change-metadata rule is retained.

open_points.subject: Status — capability-set catalog
open_points.text:
Role and principal-type
>    capability sets are static catalog data (since 2026-11-08 the data-provider
>    constant `CAPABILITY_SET_MEMBERS`, A2); there is no runtime
>    capability editing.
open_points.rule: Большие структурные доменные справочники и catalog/mapping tables тоже живут в `models`, если это domain taxonomy или upstream/downstream contract. Справочник, который читает генерируемый код, доставляет константа поставщика данных (§15.3.1): запись `models` с таким `kind` до кода не доходит.
open_points.question: The passage must define the capability-set table as a models entry with an allowed structural kind and identify CAPABILITY_SET_MEMBERS as the generated data-provider delivery of that entry.

open_points.subject: Model M13 — principal status transitions
open_points.text: `active ↔ disabled`: a disabled principal may be enabled again (Meaning; accepted `rules.status_transitions.principal`, now the data-provider constant `PRINCIPAL_STATUS_TRANSITIONS`).
open_points.rule: Большие структурные доменные справочники и catalog/mapping tables тоже живут в `models`, если это domain taxonomy или upstream/downstream contract. Справочник, который читает генерируемый код, доставляет константа поставщика данных (§15.3.1): запись `models` с таким `kind` до кода не доходит.
open_points.question: The passage must define the principal-transition table as a models mapping/catalog entry whose generated-code delivery is PRINCIPAL_STATUS_TRANSITIONS.

open_points.subject: Catalogs carried to State 2 — decided catalog homes
open_points.text:
- The candidates' homes as decided (State 2 A2, A3, A6, A7, A9, A30;
  2026-11-08): the Registry timeout, session lifetimes, credential entropy,
  money policy values, contract versions, capability sets and the staff and
  principal transitions are data-provider constants; the Registry failure
  kinds are the enumeration `RegistryFailureKind` alone; the Registry URL and
  the binary read limit stay environment values.
open_points.rule: Большие структурные доменные справочники и catalog/mapping tables тоже живут в `models`, если это domain taxonomy или upstream/downstream contract. Справочник, который читает генерируемый код, доставляет константа поставщика данных (§15.3.1): запись `models` с таким `kind` до кода не доходит.
open_points.question: The passage must distinguish scalar configuration from structural domain catalogs and define the contract-version sets, capability sets, and status-transition tables as models entries with allowed kinds before data-provider constants deliver them to generated code.
